About.title: About
About.lede: Full-Stack engineer from Bishkek. Writing code since 2022.
story: I'm from Baul village in Leilek district, Batken region — the far south of Kyrgyzstan. In 9th grade my brother Daniyar introduced me to ManchoDevs: I visited their office in Bishkek, saw the team at work and knew what I wanted to do.

Back home I taught myself: Udemy, YouTube, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React. I built mini-projects and solved LeetCode problems, often in between herding cows and sheep. An unusual path, but it got me here.

experience.text: Web apps and admin panels for 5 company products, among them finik.pay, umrahhajj, SlonExpress and mancho.school. Frontend with React and Gatsby, backend with Node.js, GraphQL and AWS. Tests with Jest, React Testing Library and Cypress, CI/CD in GitHub Actions.
Taught frontend development to 20+ students: lectures, workshops, code review, help with projects.
Built features for a product of a large telecom company with React and TypeScript.
Taught HTML, CSS and JavaScript to young people from villages who needed support.

About.mentoring: Since 2024 I give frontend lectures and workshops at Mancho School, the same school where I studied software engineering. I review code and help students with their projects. Before that I volunteered at Oigonuu NGO, teaching web basics to young people from villages.
